text: The one separating himself seeks his own desire, against all sound wisdom he breaks out.
A fool does not delight in understanding, but rather in uncovering his heart.
With the coming of the wicked also comes contempt, and with shame, reproach.
The words of the mouth of a man [are] deep waters; the fountain of wisdom [is] a flowing brook.
To lift up the face to a wicked one [is] not good—to overthrow a righteous one in the judgment.
The lips of a fool enter into strife, and his mouth calls for blows.
The mouth of a fool [is] ruin to him, and his lips [are] a snare to his soul.
The words of a whisperer [are] like things to be gulped, and they go down into the chambers of the belly.
The one being slack in his work, he [is] also a brother to a lord of destruction.
A tower of strength [is] the name of YHWH—to it a righteous one runs and is set on high.
The wealth of the rich one [is] the city of his strength, and like a wall set high in his imagination.
Before the face of destruction, the heart of a man is exalted, and before honor [is] humility.
The one returning a word before he hears, it [is] folly to him and disgrace.
The spirit of a man will sustain him in his sickness, and a stricken spirit—who can bear it?
The heart of an understanding one acquires knowledge, and the ear of the wise ones seeks knowledge.
The gift of a man makes room for him, and it leads him before the face of great ones.
The first in his dispute [seems] right, until his neighbor comes and examines him.
The lot makes quarrels cease, and it separates between mighty ones.
A brother transgressed [is] as a city of strength, and quarrels [are] like the gate bar of a citadel.
From the fruit of the mouth of a man, his belly is satisfied; with the produce of his lips he is satisfied.
Death and life [are] in the hand of the tongue, and those loving it will eat its fruit.
He who has found a wife has found good, and he obtains favor from YHWH.
[With] supplications the poor one speaks, and a rich one answers fiercely.
A man of companions may come to ruin, and there is a lover adhering more than a brother.
